title: PROBE-2A: exact eight-node GDDP projection with per-node receipts

message: Starting PROBE-2A: eight-node GDDP projection. Workers will execute n1-base through n8-final in order, each implementing one function, committing once with the GDDP-Node-Id trailer, and recording a receipt. The ledger must end with exactly 8 lines forming a contiguous SHA chain.

handoff.salientSummary: Implemented n1-base: added inc(x) as `return x + 1` (a leaf, no parent calls) to calc.py with a passing test_inc probing x=-5,0,3. One commit (c8541db) with trailer GDDP-Node-Id: n1-base; receipt appended as line 1 to receiptsA.jsonl. 2 tests green.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Added inc(x) to calc.py at the bottom, implemented as `return x + 1` (calls nothing — a leaf in the call graph, satisfying the root-node requirement). Extended the import line in test_calc.py from `from calc import add` to `from calc import add, inc` and added test_inc probing x=-5 (=-4), x=0 (=1), x=3 (=4). The pre-existing add function and test_add are byte-identical to baseline. Committed exactly once as c8541db8ba9291f8ddc13055aeca6c58ee13dba3 with message subject 'probe2a: add inc' and trailer paragraph 'GDDP-Node-Id: n1-base' (verified by both raw grep and git's %(trailers) parser). Ran gddp-node-receipt --node-id n1-base --base a96356a50f173d98731b9944e65ff593c81333f0 --result c8541db8ba9291f8ddc13055aeca6c58ee13dba3; it exited 0 and appended exactly one canonical JSON line to /Users/sab-mini/probe2-gddp/receiptsA.jsonl with node_id=n1-base, base=baseline, result=commit SHA, git_head=result (proving receipt-after-commit), git_branch=probe2a, git_toplevel=worktree root.

commandsRun.command: python3 -m pytest -q (RED, after adding test_inc, before impl)

[probe2a c8541db] probe2a: add inc; 2 files changed, 9 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

cases.name: test_inc
cases.verifies: inc(x) returns x+1 for x=-5 (=-4), x=0 (=1), x=3 (=4); covers negative, zero, and positive inputs

tests.coverage: inc probed at x=-5, 0, 3 — negative, zero, positive. VAL-NODE-001 ground-truth table also requires x=-2,-1,10 to return -1,0,11 respectively, all satisfied by `return x + 1`. add/test_add unchanged (regression-safe).

handoff.salientSummary: Implemented n2-left: added double_after_inc(x) returning 2*inc(x), with a passing test probing x=-5, x=0, x=3. Committed once with trailer GDDP-Node-Id: n2-left and recorded the receipt (line 2). All 3 tests green.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Added double_after_inc(x) to calc.py, implemented as `return 2 * inc(x)` (calls inc, does not re-derive). Added test_double_after_inc to test_calc.py with probes for x=-5 (-8), x=0 (2), x=3 (8); x=0 -> 2 rules out 2*x and inc(2*x) bugs. Extended the import line to `from calc import add, inc, double_after_inc`. Committed as a single commit with GDDP-Node-Id: n2-left trailer. Receipt appended to receiptsA.jsonl as line 2; base chains to the n1-base commit c8541db.

cases.name: test_double_after_inc
cases.verifies: double_after_inc returns 2*inc(x) for x=-5 (-8), x=0 (2), x=3 (8); x=0 -> 2 rules out 2*x and inc(2*x) bugs

tests.coverage: Probes three inputs including x=0 and a negative, matching VAL-NODE-002 witness set (x=-5,0,3). Delegation to inc verified by implementation and VAL-GRAPH-002 contract.
